tbl_description: Visual survey effort: one row per on-effort, on-transect survey segment (start/end position and time, from/to station, length). Sightings join on segment_id. Published as core `sample` rows (sample_type `transect`) with `transect_length` in `sample_measurement`.

Cetacean sightings: one row per sighting (position, time, group size best/min/max, calves, species code, effort flags, behaviour). Published as core `sample` (sample_type `sighting`, child of its transect when on effort), `obs` (group_size) and `obs_attribute` (min/max, calves, behaviour).

Species-code vocabulary used by the sightings (code, common name, suborder), with the scientific name each code is resolved from (metadata/sio/cetacean-sightings/species_codes.csv). Published as `dataset_taxon` rows.
